objective: Count how many of the six specified products have at least 1 item available today in the central Linz hardware branch.

params.store: Lookup from stores table where city='Linz' and store_name contains 'hardware' or 'Central Linz Hardware' (use pattern matching to find the specific store).
params.product_1: Identify SKU from product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand='Tork', series='Tork Wiping W', model='2RU-ZDO', and properties include cleaning_type='sponge' and pack_count='3 pcs'.
params.product_2: Identify SKU from product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand='Sikkens', series='Sikkens Exterior SIK ZRP-H5X', model='ZRP-H5X', and properties include product_type='wood sealer' and color_family='Brown'.
params.product_3: Identify SKU from product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand='Sikkens', series='Sikkens Exterior Cetol 3CU-TSJ', model='3CU-TSJ', and properties include product_type='wood stain' and color_family='White'.
params.product_4: Identify SKU from product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand='Bernardo', series='Bernardo Professional TK 2DM-OB7', model='2DM-OB7', and properties include machine_type='bench grinder' and voltage='230 V'.
params.product_5: Identify SKU from product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand='Michelin', series='Michelin Compact Radius ONB-OGX', model='ONB-OGX', and properties include product_type='battery charger', voltage='12 V', and current='4 A'.
params.product_6: Identify SKU from product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand='Karcher', series='Karcher Professional WD 1V2-NV2', model='1V2-NV2', and properties include cleaner_type='glass cleaner' and volume='2500 ml'.
